purpose: Teach: 借地/集成/私有/兼業/満了/抹消/協約/家主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の借地問題を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check on the lab's leasehold situation.
lines.style: Direct, measured. A task assignment from someone who expects competence. No inflection of doubt. Clear eye contact, brief pause for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究を集成した文献リストを作成しました
lines.en: Yes. I've compiled a literature list of prior research.
lines.style: Quiet, methodical. Proud of the work but not performing the pride. Eyes steady. A slight pause as if waiting for the next instruction to follow naturally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、私有の機材を実験に使う場合は届け出ろ
lines.en: Ren — when you use private equipment for experiments, file a report.
lines.style: Steady, professional. The tone of someone clarifying a rule, not accusing. Slight emphasis on the requirement itself, not on Ren's potential failure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。博士課程と兼業のアルバイトを学生も検討しております
lines.en: Yes. The other students are also considering combining doctoral work with part-time employment.
lines.style: Careful phrasing, as if choosing words precisely. A small hesitation — he's reading whether this answer satisfies the concern. Respectful distance in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、奨学金の貸与満了後の返済計画を立てろ
lines.en: Ren — create a repayment plan for after your scholarship term ends.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Matter-of-fact. The kind of task that signals care through practical concern, not warmth in tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。失効データを抹消する手続きをします
lines.en: Yes. I'll handle the procedure for removing expired data.
lines.style: Quiet assurance. He's understood the responsibility. No rushing—each word settled. The confidence of someone who will follow through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の協約書を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — review the cooperative research agreement.
lines.style: Another task in sequence. Steady, unrushed. The assumption that Ren will do this competently, like the others.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。下宿の家主にご挨拶に伺います
lines.en: Yes. I'll visit our landlord to pay my respects.
lines.style: Soft close. Respectful, almost formal. A small breath before answering—genuine care beneath the politeness. Voice trails gently, signaling readiness for dismissal.
